opening.argument: The presentation ties profit and bonuses directly to buying one of five product packages, then describes sponsored team placement on two sides and matching bonuses paid across generations. Those are not incidental references to education: they establish a paid, recruitment-based commission structure. It also opens with the question, “Do you want to become the next cryptocurrency millionaire?”, pairing a wealth appeal with the opportunity to earn through packages and team growth. The closing slide urges viewers, “ONE. YOUR OPPORTUNITY. NOW.” Taken together, the paid entry, tiered recruitment rewards, and immediate call to join make this an affirmative sales pitch for a recruitment-commission scheme, not reporting or criticism. The evidence supports that characterization without establishing that viewers actually lost money or became millionaires.
